notes: Registered as a dispute of the English part: in probes を before 実現 read 0.81, but English ' make' read only 0.17-0.22 and ' to' before 'ensure' 0.09. Half the fire set is English, as the label claims. The Japanese half alone could not settle it either way, so read per sentence.
